content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
The robot found the red ball and is now crouched and resting, facing it from roughly 0.3 m away. In the last camera image the ball is centred right in front of its feet.

How it got there:
- **Searching:** the ball wasn't visible from the starting spot. I walked about 1.5 m into the open part of the floor and looked around, then went another 1.5 m to the left. From there I spotted the ball far to the left, near some desks.
- **Approaching:** after one walk toward it, the ball was still off to the left, so I turned on the spot to face it. A last small turn centred it, and I stopped about 0.8 m on.

The robot said "I found the red ball" out loud before resting. Battery is at 48%.
